# CouponDonation

> Give what people need. CouponDonation is a US giving platform where people ask for help with a specific need, such as groceries, medicine, rides or household essentials, and donors give store gift cards and coupons for exactly that. 100% of each gift goes to the person who asked; nothing is paid out as cash, and every gift comes with a receipt.

CouponDonation Inc. is a US company (a Delaware corporation), not a registered 501(c)(3) charity, so gifts are not tax-deductible. Adults 18 or older in the United States can start a free request, choose their needs and up to eight stores they would use, and share their page. Donors pick a request (or give to a shared pool), choose stores such as Walmart, Kroger, Aldi, Target, CVS, Walgreens, DoorDash or Uber, and an amount from $10 per store. The team issues the gift cards and coupons by hand and adds them to the recipient's wallet; timing depends on the store. CouponDonation takes no platform fee from gifts; it runs on optional tips donors can add at checkout. It never pays bills, rent or medical providers directly. Store names are trademarks of their owners, and the stores are not affiliated with CouponDonation.

## Get help

- [Ask for help](https://coupondonation.com/apply): Start a free request for groceries, bills, rides, pharmacy items or essentials.
- [Food assistance](https://coupondonation.com/help/food-assistance): Grocery and meal gift cards, plus food banks, SNAP and WIC.
- [Grocery assistance](https://coupondonation.com/help/grocery-assistance): Gift cards for the grocery stores people already use.
- [Help paying bills](https://coupondonation.com/help/help-paying-bills): Programs for utility and phone bills, and gift cards that free up money for bills.
- [Transportation and travel assistance](https://coupondonation.com/help/transportation-assistance): Uber gift cards and programs that cover rides.
- [Healthcare assistance](https://coupondonation.com/help/healthcare-assistance): Pharmacy gift cards, plus Medicaid, health centers and prescription help.
- [Emergency assistance](https://coupondonation.com/help/emergency-assistance): Help after a fire, flood or crisis, plus Red Cross and FEMA.
- [Help with essentials](https://coupondonation.com/help/help-with-essentials): Diapers, formula, clothes, toiletries and household basics.

## Give

- [Donate](https://coupondonation.com/donate): Choose stores and an amount; give to a request or the shared pool.
- [Open requests](https://coupondonation.com/stories): Live requests with totals from completed donations.
- [Donate gift cards](https://coupondonation.com/donate-gift-cards): Give a gift card to someone who asked for one.
- [Buy groceries for a family](https://coupondonation.com/buy-groceries-for-a-family): Grocery gift cards for families who asked for help with food.
- [Holiday giving](https://coupondonation.com/holiday-giving): Sponsor a family's holiday meal or gifts.
- [CouponDonation vs GoFundMe](https://coupondonation.com/gofundme-alternative): A sourced, side-by-side comparison of fees and how help is delivered.
